rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something essential or inseparable from the thing itself, including intrinsic value.

example.english: This sense of fulfillment comes from the intrinsic value of the work itself, not from artificial additions.
example.traditional: 呢種滿足感係工作本身內在嘅價值，唔係靠人工堆出嚟。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 mun5 zuk1 gam2 hai6 gung1 zok3 bun2 san1 noi6 zoi6 ge3 gaa3 zik6 m4 hai6 kaau3 jan4 gung1 deoi1 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use this specifically when the quality is innate or present from birth, rather than an inherent property of an object.

example.english: They have an intrinsic sense of rhythm and can follow the beat after hearing a song once.
example.traditional: 佢有天生嘅節奏感，聽一次首歌就識跟住拍子。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 tin1 saang1 ge3 zit3 zau3 gam2 teng1 jat1 ci3 sau2 go1 zau6 sik1 gan1 zyu6 paak2 zi2

rows.note: Use this for an inherent property that belongs to something by its nature, especially in formal or technical wording.

example.english: Risk is an intrinsic feature of this type of investment and cannot be completely avoided.
example.traditional: 風險係呢類投資固有嘅特性，唔可以完全避免。
